04.title: Eastern Breeze - Parable of Frozen Time
description: • Programmed, Produced, Mixed & Mastered by Levc_EGM
• Original Track: Hakurei ~ Eastern Wind [博麗　～ Eastern Wind]
• Source: Touhou Fuumaroku ~ the Story of Eastern Wonderland. [東方封魔録　～ the Story of Eastern Wonderland.]

• Used VSTs & Samples: Addictive Drums 2, DPinga Congas, Addictive Keys, Play (Goliath), Mel-Lofi 2, Sforzando, Plugsound Box, Falcon (V-Horns Tenor Sax, Plugsound pro), FL Sounfont player, Super Mario RPG sample pack

• About this track: Another jazzy Touhou arrangement by me? Guess so. You know me. I love jazz. Just don't look at the heavy amount of ska albums I have on my phone with me at all times. Wait, should I make a ska arrangement? What am I even thinking. Recently, I've been listening to a lot of early Touhou music (I'm going chronologically). So when I was approached to contribute a new arrangement, I went with one of my favorites! It's a simple melody. But it allows me to expand it in some fun ways! I think it sounds good. No but seriously, when's the Touhou Ska album happening-

05.title: Sueňo Místico ~ O Nieve o Pétalo de Cerezo
description: • Piano, Upright Bass, Flute, Saxophone, Guiro, Conga, Tumbadora, Taped Cymbal & Cowbells: Someone45356
• Programmed, Produced, Mixed & Mastered by Someone45356
• Additional Mastering: DC Offset filter, EQ, Limiting, Ceiling
• Original Track: Ghostly Dream ~ Snow or Cherry Petal [妖々夢　～ Snow or Cherry Petal]
• Source: Touhou Youyoumu ~ Perfect Cherry Blossom. [東方妖々夢　～ Perfect Cherry Blossom.]
• Used Software: Logic Pro for iPad
• Used VSTs & Samples: Orchestral Tools Andea, Splice, SWAM, Ink Audio Amateur Orchestra

• About this track: I thought chachá would be an interesting type of music to try for a barista or coffee shop feel, that is hispanoamerican and still fits the vibe more or less. I was told I didn’t need to worry about that too much, but well I still put some thought into it. The track itself too was also a pick I chose for that precise reason, its very straight forward and simple for a touhou song, and so I thought it would be good for a rendition.

07.title: Inaba's Day Off
description: • Mastering Engineer: malicent (Cursed Monastery / Sigillum Azoetia)
• Original Track: Lunatic Eyes ~ Invisible Full Moon [狂気の瞳　～ Invisible Full Moon]
• Source: Touhou Eiyashou ~ Imperishable Night. [東方永夜抄　～ Imperishable Night.]
• Used VSTs & Samples: Numa Player, Korg Module, Apple loops, restaurant ambience from Fesliyan Studios

• About this track: I chose Inaba's theme because any rest for Inaba is practically unheard of, given that she's a full-time student and servant. Her original theme is also quite chaotic; the harmonious chorus in 4/4 clashes with the meandering verses in 6/4. "Inaba's Day Off" is a tamer interpretation of the theme, as everything is pulled into 4/4 so it can breathe.

09.title: HEAVENGINE
description: • Composer, Arranger & Lyrics: Arman Aspromonti (Resonant Union)
• Electric Guitar & Synths: Arman Aspromonti (Resonant Union)
• Programmed, Produced, Mixed & Mastered by Arman Aspromonti (Resonant Union)
• Used VSTs & Samples: IK Multimedia Amplitube 5, KORG Prophecy, Native Instruments FM8, BFD3, Prominy SR5 Rock Bass

R-Man: In a place outside time and space, two people drive down an endless highway with no goal in sight and no company other than each other and a sun that's permanently suspended just above the horizon. They don't know how they got there, or where they're going, but they take a strange kind of comfort in knowing the only thing ahead of them is certain doom.
I caught a glimpse of your smile,
Our journey to nowhere goes on and on.
The lamps that light the highway,
They shine like stars on the endless road ahead.
Road to the new world goes on and on.
Why does the moon chase the sun?
to see a future where we'd survive.
cut the past away from us.

15.title: Waltz for the Ocean
description: • Classical Guitar II & III: Michael Stokol (Resonant Union)
• Programmed, Produced & Mixed by Michael Stokol (Resonant Union)
• Used VSTs & Samples: FabFilter (Pro-Q 3, Pro-C 2, Saturn 2), iZotope RX 8 Voice De-noise, Logic Pro (EQ, Space Designer), IK Multimedia T-RackS 6 Bus Compressor

• About this track: I have a hyperfixation on anime scores which bring together classical guitars and water. I wrote this piece inspired by these shows back in 2023 for my university's guitar ensemble, but re-worked it with new recordings and a newly arranged percussion part by E-Sarge!

description.en: "Lady Patchouli, care for another cup of tea?" Seems like the Moriya shrine maiden got a new hire, and with that, the whole Scarlet Devil mansion has come forward to taste some new beverage! "Moriya Barista 2" will be the perfect new addition to your music rotation whenever you want to cool down, or share a warm and bittersweet cup of coffee with the local yokais.
description.jp: 「パチュリー様、お紅茶をもう一杯いかがですか？」どうやら守矢神社の魔法使いが新しい仲間を迎えたようで、紅魔館の方々も、新たな一杯を味わいにやって来ました！『Moriya Barista 2』は、ひと息つきたい時や、妖怪たちと温かくほろ苦いコーヒーを囲んで穏やかな時間を過ごしたい時にぴったりな、新たなお気に入りの一枚になることでしょう。
